scenes.context: 关键帧是动态效果的灵魂，本期系统教学。
sentences: 不用关键帧的剪辑是没有灵魂的。
Editing without keyframes has no soul.
Keyframes = soul of editing.
关键帧是什么？关键帧到底怎么用？一个视频给你聊透。
What are keyframes? How do you use them? One video covers it all.
The full explainer.
scenes.speak: Editing without keyframes has no soul. What are keyframes? How do you use them? One video covers it all.

scenes.title_cn: 关键帧概念：就是时间轴上的小菱形，按…
scenes.title_en: The concept: keyframes are small diamonds …
sentences: 关键帧就是时间轴上的这个小菱形，有个加号时按下就能添加关键帧。
Keyframes are these small diamonds on the timeline—when there's a plus, tap to add one.
The little diamond.
说白了他就是在两个关键帧之间形成渐变变化的效果，而不是突然变化。
Simply put, it creates a gradual change between two keyframes instead of a sudden one.
Gradual, not sudden.
scenes.speak: Keyframes are these small diamonds on the timeline—when there's a plus, tap to add one. Simply put, it creates a gradual change between two keyframes instead of a sudden one.

scenes.title_cn: 玩法一·变大变小：在开头打一个关键帧…
scenes.title_en: Trick 1 · Scale: add a keyframe at the sta…
scenes.context: 缩放效果让画面更有张力。
sentences: 比如想让画面逐渐变大，我们就在前面打上一个关键帧。
To make the shot gradually grow, add a keyframe at the front.
Mark the start.
然后拉动我们的时间轴，把双指放到画面上，从里到外放大。
Then drag the timeline forward and pinch outward on the frame to zoom in.
Pinch to zoom.
看，此刻有个关键帧自动形成了，画面慢慢变大。
See—a keyframe auto-forms and the shot slowly grows.
The gradual grow effect.
scenes.speak: To make the shot gradually grow, add a keyframe at the front. Then drag the timeline forward and pinch outward on the frame to zoom in. See—a keyframe auto-forms and the shot slowly grows.

scenes.title_cn: 玩法二·画面变亮变暗：想让画面慢慢变…
scenes.title_en: Trick 2 · Fade in/out: to fade the shot ou…
scenes.context: 淡出效果常用于结尾告别。
sentences: 比如想让画面慢慢变暗，像是结尾时和人说完拜拜，不想那么快离开。
To slowly fade the shot out—like saying bye at the end and not wanting to leave so fast.
A soft goodbye.
那就在结尾处的前面打上一个关键帧，再拖到最后。
Add a keyframe before the ending, then drag to the very end.
Start and end points.
找到不透明度，把不透明度拉到最左，画面慢慢变暗了。
Find opacity, slide it all the way left, and the frame slowly darkens.
Opacity to zero.
scenes.speak: To slowly fade the shot out—like saying bye at the end and not wanting to leave so fast. Add a keyframe before the ending, then drag to the very end. Find opacity, slide it all the way left, and the frame slowly darkens.

scenes.title_cn: 玩法三·改变位置：让贴纸小人走动起来…
scenes.title_en: Trick 3 · Position: make a sticker charact…
scenes.context: 关键帧实现元素位移，适合旅游vlog。
sentences: 在贴纸素材开头打上一个关键帧，然后向右移动时间轴，移动一下画面里的贴纸。
Add a keyframe at the sticker's start, move the timeline right, and drag the sticker.
Keyframe then move.
再次向右移动时间轴，贴纸继续移动位置。
Move the timeline right again and keep moving the sticker.
Add more keyframes.
播放视频，我们就可以看到贴纸的丝滑运动轨迹。
Play the video and you'll see the sticker's smooth motion path.
Smooth motion path.
这个操作就可以用在记录旅游vlog的时候使用。
This trick works great for travel vlogs.
Great for travel vlogs.
scenes.speak: Add a keyframe at the sticker's start, move the timeline right, and drag the sticker. Move the timeline right again and keep moving the sticker. Play the video and you'll see the sticker's smooth motion path. This trick works great for travel vlogs.

scenes.title_cn: 玩法四·改变颜色：给文字变色。点击文…
scenes.title_en: Trick 4 · Color: change text color. Tap th…
scenes.context: 文字变色强调重点语句。
sentences: 要给文字变色，点击文字素材，点击编辑，点击样式。
To change text color, tap the text clip, then Edit, then Style.
Text style menu.
在开头处打上一个关键帧，向右移动时间轴，挑选一下文字变化的颜色。
Add a keyframe at the start, move the timeline right, and pick the new color.
Keyframe the color.
就这样文字颜色渐变的效果就完成了，可以用在强调文字语句。
And there's the color transition—perfect for emphasizing key lines.
Emphasize with color.
scenes.speak: To change text color, tap the text clip, then Edit, then Style. Add a keyframe at the start, move the timeline right, and pick the new color. And there's the color transition—perfect for emphasizing key lines.

scenes.title_cn: 玩法五·声音变化：用音乐大小体现节奏…
scenes.title_en: Trick 5 · Volume: use music volume for rhy…
scenes.context: 关键帧控制音量起伏，突出重点。
sentences: 点击音乐素材，点击节拍，选择自动踩点。
Tap the music clip, tap Beat, and choose Auto Beat-Drop.
Auto-detect the beats.
然后在小黄点处都打上一个关键帧，在第一个小黄点处把音乐音量向左拉到零。
Add a keyframe at each yellow dot and pull the first one's volume to zero.
Silence on the first beat.
在第二个小黄点处把音乐声音拉大，以此类推。
Raise the volume on the second dot, and so on.
Loud and quiet alternating.
通常我们在视频开始讲话或者重点信息的时候，也会让音乐降低，不去干扰我们讲话。
When you start talking or hitting key info, you also lower the music so it doesn't interfere.
Keep music clear of speech.
scenes.speak: Tap the music clip, tap Beat, and choose Auto Beat-Drop. Add a keyframe at each yellow dot and pull the first one's volume to zero. Raise the volume on the second dot, and so on. When you start talking or hitting key info, you also lower the music so it doesn't interfere.

scenes.title_cn: 玩法六·蒙版变化：点击素材找到蒙版，…
scenes.title_en: Trick 6 · Mask: tap the clip to find Mask;…
scenes.context: 蒙版+关键帧组合出丰富转场。
sentences: 点击素材，向右滑动菜单栏，找到蒙版。
Tap the clip, swipe the menu right, and find Mask.
Find the mask menu.
选择线性蒙版，我们可以呈现背景变化的转场效果。
Pick a linear mask to make a background-change transition.
Linear mask transitions.
选择镜面蒙版，可以呈现电影开场的效果。
A mirror mask gives a cinematic opening.
Cinematic opener.
圆形和矩形蒙版，就可以多应用在口播视频，强调主题重点话语。
Circle and rectangle masks suit talking-head videos to emphasize key lines.
Highlight talking points.
scenes.speak: Tap the clip, swipe the menu right, and find Mask. Pick a linear mask to make a background-change transition. A mirror mask gives a cinematic opening. Circle and rectangle masks suit talking-head videos to emphasize key lines.

practice: It creates gradual change between two keyframes.
Add a keyframe, then pinch outward to zoom.
Drop the volume to zero on the first beat.
A linear mask makes a background-change transition.
pitfalls: Expect a sudden jump between keyframes.
Keyframes create gradual change, not jumps.
关键帧是渐变不是突变。
Move the timeline without adding a keyframe.
Add a start keyframe before moving the timeline.
先打起始关键帧再移动时间轴。
Zoom the whole frame for an effect.
Pinch on the frame after the start keyframe.
双指放大画面会自动生成关键帧。
Keep the music loud while speaking.
Drop the music when you start talking.
讲话或重点信息时音乐要降低。
shifts: 用 keyframe（关键帧）、gradual change（渐变）、auto-form（自动形成）
用 opacity（不透明度）、auto beat-drop（自动踩点）、mask（蒙版）
用 linear mask（线性蒙版）、mirror mask（镜面蒙版）、fade out（淡出）
